text:
hannah: Quick sync: three docs PRs touching versioned guides + an SDK example that needs to be slotted into the May release. Can reviewers chime in on merge timing?
leo: Which PRs?
hannah: #4200 (versioned: auth flow update), #4211 (SDK example + snippet), #4214 (link fixes + migration notes). Links in the PR descriptions.
olivia: I can take #4211. Heads-up: the preview image currently uses the old SDK package name which will 404 if we merge the new snippet straight to main.
emma: Release schedule: feature-flag rollout scheduled 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC. Cutoff for docs to be present in the release branch is 2026-05-09 23:59 UTC.
leo: Can we publish the SDK page behind versioned docs (v2.2) and keep a compatibility note on v2.1? That's our usual approach.
hannah: Plan A: merge to release/v2.2 branch with frontmatter `hidden: true` and ship; after rollout flip the flag and remove compatibility note. Plan B: keep in a draft page and only publish post-rollout.
olivia: Drafting is safer but will require a manual publish step later. Might be annoying for product folks.
preview-bot: [preview] PR #4211 preview available: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4211 
leo: For the auth flow (#4200) I saw a rename of `authorize_session` => `authorize_request`. That will break code samples in older minor versions. We should add a prominent note in v2.1 and update the versioned migration guide.
hannah: Agreed. Add a short callout block in v2.1: "Note: function rename in v2.2" and link to migration doc (#4214).
emma: For the SDK snippet, an alternative to hiding is to include both snippets with a short comment and a single build-time toggle that picks which to render. But our static site generator doesn't support runtime toggles in preview.
olivia: Right — adding both snippets keeps previews green and removes the need to rebuild preview images. But it's a little noisy.
leo: I prefer both snippets + a small paragraph: "v2.1 (current) / v2.2 (new)" and then remove v2.1 snippet after rollout. Create a follow-up issue to revert.
hannah: OK that's our working decision. Olivia, do the dual-snippet and add `hidden: true` frontmatter on the main landing until rollout is complete. Also add `---` frontmatter note: `rollout_date: 2026-05-10T02:00:00Z`.
olivia: Will do. I'll push the change and trigger preview.
preview-bot: [preview] rebuild queued for PR #4211 by olivia  https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4211/refresh
leo: Merge window? We need buffer before cutoff. I suggest merging to release/v2.2 by 2026-05-09 16:00 UTC to allow for unexpected fixes.
emma: That matches our release train. If any preview failures show up after that, we should hold and escalate.
hannah: I'll coordinate the merge at 2026-05-09 15:30 UTC and post a final call here 1 hour prior. If anyone can't make it, flag now.
olivia: I may be offline after 17:00 UTC but can do the PR work earlier.
leo: I'll review #4200 this afternoon. Minor nit: update code blocks to use fenced triple backticks with language tag for syntax highlighting.
preview-bot: [status] PR #4200: checks passing. PR #4211: preview ready. PR #4214: awaiting review.
emma: If #4214 (link fixes) doesn't get final sign-off by 2026-05-09 12:00 UTC, we postpone it to post-release patch to avoid last-minute churn.
hannah: Sounds good. I'll also add a short rollback note in the release checklist: "if docs break, revert release/v2.2 to pre-merge commit and inform docs@redwood".
olivia: Patch pushed to #4211: dual-snippet, hidden frontmatter, and `preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4211` in the PR body.
leo: Quick glance looks fine. Leaving detailed review for later.
emma: Thanks everyone. I'll ping here 1h before merge and again at merge time. :white_check_mark:
